name: Toscano / Terza / Local Italian (Draper & Herriman) Grilled Chicken or Salmon with Olive Oil Capellini & Potato Gnocchi
whyItWorks: At Toscano in Draper, ordering grilled chicken breast or Atlantic salmon over delicate angel-hair capellini or soft potato gnocchi tossed simply in extra-virgin olive oil, broth, and aged Parmigiano-Reggiano avoids heavy cream and acidic tomato marinara.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask for Grilled Chicken Breast or Salmon with capellini pasta or potato gnocchi tossed in light olive oil, chicken broth, and grated Parmigiano-Reggiano (no lemon butter, no red chili flakes, and no heavy cream Alfredo).
watchOuts: Skip lemon-caper piccata sauce (citrus trigger) and spicy arrabbiata tomato sauce
